sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ext_bean_def (c0 TEXT, c1 TEXT, c2 TEXT)
INSERT INTO ext_bean_def (c0, c1, c2) SELECT 'svc', type_id, 'stereotype' FROM symbols WHERE display='Svc' AND method_id IS NULL
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ext_inject_point (c0 TEXT, c1 TEXT, c2 TEXT, c3 TEXT, c4 TEXT)

INSERT INTO ext_inject_point (c0, c1, c2, c3, c4) SELECT 'field', 'svc', (SELECT type_id FROM symbols WHERE display='Svc' AND method_id IS NULL), (SELECT type_id FROM symbols WHERE display='Client' AND method_id IS NULL), '-'

checks.why: a call from inside the bean goes through this, never through the container proxy, so an added proxied annotation does not apply to it
a caller that receives the bean by injection is the one that does get the new behaviour
